front.intro: This East End bungalow was updated from the foundation up, so the big-ticket work is already done. The wiring and breaker box are new, three-phase power is in, and the plumbing and the roof are new too. New Hardi Plank siding wraps the house, and the foundation was reworked, leveled and braced before any of it went in. Inside, new flooring, trim, paint and lighting carry from the Living room through the Dining area to an open Kitchen with stainless appliances. The Primary Bedroom has a vaulted ceiling with a painted beam, and both baths are all new. Out back, a covered garage and a patio sit in a fenced yard.
front.around: Just minutes from Downtown and EaDo, with Downtown Houston 3.5 miles away. A neighborhood coffee shop on Telephone Road is under half a mile. Navigation Esplanade, Original Ninfa's and El Tiempo are about 2 miles. Cullinan Park is 0.3 miles. Bohemeo's is 0.6 miles from here.
front.cap: One open run stretches from the dining area to the front door, with the living room on the left and the kitchen peninsula on the right. Navy lower cabinets sit under white shaker-style uppers, beside stainless appliances.
front.cap1: Board-and-batten fills the gable above a Craftsman-style front door, with a concrete walk leading up to the porch steps and a row of low green shrubs along the front of the house.
front.cap2: Past the covered garage, a concrete drive leads along the side of the lot to the fenced yard and its tall shade tree behind the house.

top.title: An open front, seen room to room

strips.name: Living room + front entry
strips.text: The front door opens straight into the Living room, so there is no entry hall to cross before you reach the seating. A wide cased opening joins the room to the Dining area and the open Kitchen, which keeps the front of the house in one line of sight. The wiring behind the room is new, and so is the breaker box that feeds it. The Craftsman-style door has a divided-light window that lets a little light into the entry.
strips.cap: Front entry: the door has divided panes, and the Living room starts right inside.

strips.name: Kitchen + pantry
strips.text: An L-shaped Kitchen with a peninsula, all new from the plumbing out. Stone-look counters climb the wall as a full-height backsplash behind the range. A stainless range sits under a chimney hood, and the sink sits under a window beside the dishwasher. Two pendant lights hang over the peninsula, which seats barstools on one side and gives you prep space on the other.
strips.cap: The Pantry measures 4'7" x 3'4" and sits just off the new Kitchen.

strips.name: Dining area + breakfast nook
strips.text: The Dining area sits between the Kitchen peninsula and the hall to the bedrooms, under a sputnik-style light. A round table fits with room to walk around it. Windows fill two walls of the Breakfast Nook at the back of the Kitchen. Its rear door opens to a small deck, with steps down to the fenced yard. No door or step separates the Dining area from the Living room.
strips.cap: Breakfast Nook at 8'1" x 8'9", with glass on two walls and a door to the deck.

bottom.kicker: The back half of the house
bottom.title: Bedrooms, baths and the closets between

strips.name: Primary bedroom + bath
strips.text: The Primary sits at the back of the house, away from the street, under the only vaulted ceiling in the home. A window looks out to mature trees, and the carpet runs wall to wall. In the bath, double sinks sit in a marble-look top on a dark navy vanity with drawers. A wide LED mirror lights the wall, and a window sits high above it. The walk-in shower is a few steps from the bed.
strips.cap: Primary bath with double sinks, a navy vanity and a walk-in shower only a few steps from the bed.

strips.name: Bedroom 2 + Bedroom 3
strips.text: Windows on two walls bring light into Bedroom 2, the bigger of the two, at the front corner of the house. Both rooms have new carpet underfoot. The window wall in Bedroom 3 leaves room for a desk. The closet sits on the hall side, which leaves the window wall open. Fresh paint finishes both rooms. A hall with wood-look floors connects them to the open Kitchen.
strips.cap: Bedroom 3, 13'7" x 11'3", looks out through its window wall and has new carpet.

strips.name: Primary closet + hall bath
strips.text: Double doors open to the Primary closet, with a shelving tower down the center and hanging rods on both sides. More shelves above hold bins or luggage, and the built-ins stay with the house. The floor is marble-look tile too, and a black vanity carries an LED backlit mirror. Deep built-in linen shelves sit just outside the door for towels and extra supplies. Everything in the bath is new, from the plumbing to the fixtures.
strips.cap: Hall bath with a black vanity, a lit mirror and all-new fixtures, plus linen shelves right outside the door.

back.title: Covered space and the East End
back.planNote: The front porch is at the street end of the plan. The hall to the bedrooms starts at the Dining area. Approximate and not to scale; the buyer verifies room sizes.
back.roomsNote: From the street the house reads Living room first, then Dining area and Kitchen in one line. The Breakfast Nook sits at the back of the Kitchen, with a door to the rear deck. The Primary Bedroom and its bath are at the back of the house. The covered garage and the patio sit side by side in the fenced yard.

big.name: Covered garage
big.text: Heavy wood posts and a solid roof cover a space with a wood plank back wall and a concrete floor. It is covered parking, a workshop or an outdoor kitchen and lounge, depending on what you need. A new driveway runs down the side of the lot to it. The fenced yard keeps it private. String lights are already up, and a mature shade tree stands behind it. The patio sits right alongside, open to the yard.

small.name: Patio and deck
small.text: Past the deck steps from the Breakfast Nook, the patio runs the length of the covered garage. Open yard space lies on its other side, between the patio and the fence.

items: Rewired, with a new breaker panel
